text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... gasp...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine. I just... wasn't good<n>enough!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I couldn't catch up to Bourbon! I have<n>to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I have to... work harder...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Her strength exhausted, she<n>collapses before me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I rush forward to lend her my<n>shoulder to rest on.
And as I do...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Her choice of words does not match<n>the scenario
we are in.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Considering the outcome of the race,<n>she should
have said she "lost."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is not a matter of whether she<n>"caught up" to me
or not. Should you<n>not correct her?
choice_data_list: Catching up to you is what was important to her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This... does not compute.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I didn't mean cause you<n>trouble...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... There's no hope for me, isthere?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm such a burden to you... And even<n>when racing...
I can't keep up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I have to work even harder next time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Tell me... what race do you think<n>Bourbon will run in
next?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Tell me... what race do you think<n>Bourbon will run in
next?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I think you're right. Then, that<n>means... I'm going
too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm... going to do my best. And next<n>time... I'll catch
up to her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is the final race in the<n>Triple Crown
tour—a 3000-meter<n>long-distance turf race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since Rice Shower is a stayer, that<n>means her
chances of victory are the<n>highest they've ever
been!
